title: RAND is headquartered at 1776 Main Street in Santa Monica
summary: RAND's current first-party contact page labels Santa Monica as Headquarters and gives 1776 Main Street as its delivery address. This is explicit headquarters evidence rather than an inference from a contact or mailing address.

data.subject: starintel:org:rand-corporation
data.note: Current first-party RAND contact page explicitly labels Santa Monica as Headquarters; Washington, Pittsburgh, Boston, RAND Europe, and RAND Australia are separately listed as offices.
